name: ui-table
description: Bootstrap 6 table for a light-DOM <table>: theme variants, striped rows/columns, hover, borders, small, alignment, card-like, responsive and stacked (by breakpoint).

descriptions.--bs-table-striped-color: Text colour of striped rows / columns.
descriptions.--bs-table-striped-bg-factor: Share of the text colour in the stripe background.
descriptions.--bs-table-active-bg-factor: Share of the text colour in the active background.
descriptions.--bs-table-hover-color: Text colour of a hovered row.
descriptions.--bs-table-hover-bg-factor: Share of the text colour in the hover background.
descriptions.--bs-table-color-state: Internal: colour of the states (active, hover).
descriptions.--bs-table-bg-state: Internal: background of the states (active, hover).
